title: Lizmap synchronisation manifest
description: Recursive listing of a directory on the server, returned in a single request. Version 1.0 is served by the Lizmap WebDAV module 1.3, with GET on a collection and the 'manifest' query parameter.

version.description: Version of the manifest format, 'MAJOR.MINOR'. A client must refuse an unknown major version and ignore unknown properties.

root.description: Listed directory, relative to the WebDAV root, with a trailing slash. Empty for the root itself.

generated_at.description: Generation time of the manifest, in seconds since the epoch (UTC).

checksum_algorithm.description: Algorithm used for the 'checksum' property of the files.

checksum_max_size.description: Files bigger than this size, in bytes, do not have a checksum. Null if there isn't any limit.

dirs.description: All sub-directories, empty ones included, relative to 'root', without trailing slash.

files.description: All files, recursively. Temporary files of the server, such as partial uploads, are not listed.

relativePath.description: Relative path with '/' as separator, in the Unicode NFC form, without '.' or '..' segments.

mtime.description: Last modification time on the server, in seconds since the epoch (UTC).

etag.description: Same value as the HTTP ETag header of the file, quotes included, usable with 'If-Match'.

checksum.description: Checksum of the content in lowercase hexadecimal, or null if the file is bigger than 'checksum_max_size'.
